description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableTopicPath' implementing the 'TopicPath' interface, representing a structured, readonly topic path used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It includes factory methods to create instances with different parameters, handles validation, and constructs a topic path string based on its properties.

classes.name: ImmutableTopicPath
classes.description: An immutable, final class implementing the TopicPath interface that provides thread-safe, read-only representations of topic paths with various configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create ImmutableTopicPath instances with different sets of parameters, handling validation and object construction.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component of the topic path.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group component of the topic path.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel component of the topic path.

methods.name: getCriterion
methods.description: Returns the criterion component of the topic path.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the action if present.

methods.name: getSearchAction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the search action if present.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the subject string if present.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full string representation of the topic path.
